_en_original: Perform a basic attack. Can only hit directly in front of you.
en: Deal damage equal to your Power. Can only target in front of you.
tr: Gücün kadar hasar ver. Sadece hemen önünü hedefleyebilir.
uk: Нанеси удар, рівний твоїй Силі. Можна вдарити тільки ціль перед собою.

en: Deal damage equal to your Power.

_en_original: Your Attack heals instead of dealing damage. Whenever a target is hit by slung slop, it receives a “No more, please” status that lasts for two turns.
en:
Heal for an amount equal to your Power, then apply “No More, Please!”.
If the target already had “No More, Please!”, they become Stunned and lose their next turn.
tr:
Gücün kadar iyileştir, ardından “Benden Bu Kadar!” uygula.
Hedefte “Benden Bu Kadar!” zaten varsa, Sersemler ve sıradaki turunu kaybeder.
uk:
Вилікуй ціль на кількість, рівну твоїй Силі і надай статус "Молю, Досить!".
Якщо ціль вже мала "Молю, Досить!", вона стає Приголомшеною і пропускає свій хід.

en:
Deal damage equal to your Power.
Counts as Explosive and Sparking damage.
tr:
Gücün kadar hasar ver.
Hem Patlayıcı hem Yakıcı hasar sayılır.
uk: Нанеси удар, рівний твоїй Силі. Рахується Вибуховувою і Іскристою атаками.

en: Deal damage equal to your Power.

_en_original: Deal damage equal to your POW, then heal for the same amount.
en:
Deal damage equal to your Power, then heal for the same amount.
Does not end your turn.
tr:
Gücün kadar hasar ver, ardından aynı miktarda iyileştir.
Turunu geçirmez.

en: Deal damage equal to your Power.

Deal damage equal to your Power.
Counts as Sparking damage.
tr:
Gücün kadar hasar ver.
Yakıcı hasar sayılır.
uk:
Нанеси удар, рівний твоїй Силі.
Рахується за Іскристу шкоду.

_en_original: Take a charging stance. At the beginning of your team’s next turn, deliver a devastating 40-damage punch in front of you.
en: Take a charging stance. Next turn, deal 40 damage in front of you.
tr: Hazırlık durumuna geç. Gelecek tur, bir ileriye 40 hasar ver.
uk: Замахнися для удару. Нанеси 40 шкоди цілі перед собою наступого ходу.

_en_original: Drag an enemy cat to the front of its party, no matter the position, dealing 10 damage to it in the process.
en: Deal 10 damage to the target, then pull them to the front.
tr: Hedefe 10 hasar ver, ardından en öne çek.
uk: Нанеси 10 шкоди цілі і притягни їх вперед.

_en_original: Reposition the big pot (called Sootgut) onto any other position. While on the spot with Sootgut, a cat receives a 50% reduction to all incoming attack damage.
en: Move Sootgut to provide cover for the target, halving all incoming attack damage.
tr: Arkasına sığınması için Külkarni’yi hedefe göndererek ona gelen saldırı hasarını yarıla.
uk: Перемісти Казан, щоб прикрити товариша, зменшуючи втрату Здоров'я на 50%.

_en_original: Throw a bag of blackpowder onto a spot. Dealing explosive damage to that satchel makes it BLOW for 25 damage to that spot and 15 damage to adjacent spots.
en: Throw black powder at the target. Explosive damage makes it blow up for 25 damage to that spot and 15 to adjacent spots.
tr: Hedefe doğru kara barut at. Patlayıcı hasar barutu patlatarak o sıraya 25 ve yanlarına 15’er hasar verir.
uk: Кинь у ціль Мішок з Порохом. Вибухові атаки підривають Мішок, наносячи 25 шкоди цілі і 15 по сусіднім.

_en_original: Look through the spyglass at a target. Shoot a beam of lens-focused energy, dealing 5 damage and doubling heal or damage received by the target in the next 3 instances.
en:
Deal 5 damage to the target, then apply a status doubling the next 3 instances of incoming healing and damage.
Counts as Sparking damage.
tr:
Hedefe 5 hasar ver, ardından sıradaki 3 kez alınan iyileştirme ve hasarı ikiye katlayan bir statü uygula.
Yakıcı hasar sayılır.
uk:
Нанеси 5 шкоди цілі. Надай цліі статус, який збільшує отриману ній шкоду і зцілення наступні 3 рази.
Рахується за Іскристу атаку.

_en_original: Scatter some nuts on a spot. If the nuts are not picked up until your next turn, a flock of seagulls will swoop in to fight for the nuts, dealing 20 damage to the cat standing on the spot, and applying 1 Nasty Cuts stack.
en: Scatter nuts around the target. If they use Crunch on their turn, they are healed for 10 Health. Otherwise, seagulls swoop in, dealing 20 damage and applying Nasty Cuts.
tr: Hedefin etrafına fıstık saç. Eğer kendi turunda Çitleme kullanırsa, hedefin 10 Canı iyileşir. Aksi takdirde martılar çullanarak hedefe 20 hasar verir ve Fena Kesikler’e neden olur.
uk: Розсип Арахіс під ціллю. Якщо ціль зточить Арахів під час свого ходу, вона лікується на 10 Здоров'я. Інакше налетять чайки і нанесуть Глибокі Порізи.

_en_original: Throw a mug of rum at any cat in the game (Ally or enemy). Target receives a permanent +40% damage bonus and a stack of “Smashed”, which makes them miss their next attack or damaging skill. Target also becomes Flammable.
en: Grants the target a 40% damage bonus, but also causes them to miss their next action. The next time they take Sparking damage, they catch fire, taking 30 damage and losing their next turn.
tr: Hedefin hasarını %40 artırır, ama sıradaki aksiyonunu ıskalamasına neden olur. Hedef daha sonra Yakıcı hasar alırsa tutuşarak 30 hasar alır ve sıradaki turunu kaybeder.
uk: Підсилює атаки цілі на 50% і змушує їх промазати наступного ходу. Наступного разу, коли цілі нанесена Іскриста шкода, вона запалюється, отримує 30 шкоди і пропускає свій наступний хід.

_en_original: Perform a basic attack, with another basic attack being shot at a random enemy.
en: Perform a Basic Attack once on the target, and again on a random mutineer.
tr: Bir kez hedefe, bir kez de rastgele bir isyancıya Temel Saldırı kullan.
uk: Атакуй ціль і одного випадкового ворога.

_en_original: Crunch on the peanuts, leaving none for the seagulls to fight over, and getting healed for 10 HP.
en: Crunch on the nuts, getting healed for 10 Health, and leaving none for the seagulls.
tr: Fıstıkları çitleyerek 10 Canını iyileştir, martılara hiç bırakma.
uk: Сточи арахіс і зцілись на 10 Здоров'я, не лишаючи нічого для чайок.

_en_original: Swap places with an adjacent ally.
en: Swap places with an adjacent target.

_en_original: Damage you deal inflicts Nasty Cuts. You get a stack of Nasty Cuts at the end of every turn.
en: Damage you deal applies Nasty Cuts, but you gain Nasty Cuts at the end of each turn.
tr: Verdiğin hasar Fena Kesiklere yol açar, ama her tur sonunda sen de bir Fena Kesik alırsın.
uk: Твої атаки наносять Глибокі Порізи, але ти також отримуєш Глибокі Порізи в кінці кожного ходу.

_en_original: You can’t be moved, either by yourself or forcefully.
en: You can’t move or be moved.
uk: Тебе не можуть зрушити з місця.

_en_original: Damage you deal and receive has 30% chance to deal +50% damage.
en: Damage you deal or take has a 30% chance to increase by 50%.
tr: Aldığın ve verdiğin hasar %30 ihtimalle %50 artar.
uk: Твої атаки мають 30% шанс стати сильніше на 50%.

_en_original: Your HP is 1, but you deal triple damage.
en: You deal triple damage, but your Health is set to 1.
tr: Hasarın üç kat etkili, ama 1 Canla başlarsın.
uk: Ти наносиш втричі більше шкоди, але твоє Здоров'я знижено до 1.

_en_original: You reflect 30% of the incoming damage onto an adjacent ally.
en: You reflect 30% of incoming damage onto a random adjacent crewmate.
tr: Alınan hasarın %30’u bitişik rastgele bir müttefiğe yönlendirilir.
uk: Ти відбиваєш 30% шкоди на випадкового товариша.

_en_original: You can’t use your basic attack anymore.
en: You can’t use your Basic Attack.
uk: Ти не можеш використовувати Базову Атаку.

_en_original: Every time you Attack, you deal flat extra +4 damage.
en: Your Basic Attack deals an additional 4 damage.
uk: Твоя Базова Атака наносить на 4 більше шкоди.

_en_original: First three instances of damage in a fight are negated. After the third hit, the vest cracks and you’re stunned for a turn.
en: Ignore the first 3 instances of incoming damage. After the 3rd, the vest cracks, causing you to become Stunned and lose your next turn.
tr: İlk 3 kez alınan hasarı görmezden gel. 3’üncüden sonra yelek kırılarak Sersemlemene ve sıradaki turunu kaybetmene neden olur.
uk: Обнуляє 3 атаки спрямовані на тебе. Після 3-ї Камізелька розпадається, Приголомшує і змушує тебе пропустити наступний хід.

_en_original: Your Attacks make the target move backwards.
en: Your Basic Attack knocks the target back.
uk: Твоя Базова Атака відкидує ціль назад.

_en_original: Moving is now a free action.
en: Repositioning no longer ends your turn.

_en_original: Start the battle with 3 stacks of Poison. Get a 25% increase to POW.
en: Your Power increases by 25%, but you start with 3 stacks of Poison.
tr: Gücün %25 artar, ama 3 kat Zehirle başlarsın.
uk: Твоя Сила збільшується на 25%, але ти починаєш битву з 3 стеками Яду.

_en_original: Your ability gains a cooldown of 1 turn. After using the ability, attack is temporarily stronger.
en: Your Skill gains a cooldown of 1 turn, but using it empowers your next Basic Attack by 50%.
tr: Yeteneğin 1 tur gecikmeli yenilenir, ama kullanımı sıradaki Temel Saldırını %50 güçlendirir.
uk: Твої навички відновлюються після 1 ходу, але твої атаки на 50% сильніші.

_en_original: When receiving damage, you heal adjacent teammates for 5 HP.
en: Whenever you take damage, adjacent crewmates are healed for 5 Health.
tr: Her hasar aldığında bitişik müttefiklerin 5’er Canı iyileşir.
uk: Твої товариші лікуються на 5 Здоров'я, коли ти втрачаєш Здоров'я

_en_original: Your Attacks make the target unable to move by itself on their next turn.
en: Your Basic Attack prevents the target from Repositioning on their next turn.
tr: Temel Saldırın hedefin sıradaki turunda Yer Değiştirmesini engeller.
uk: Твоя Базова Атака не дозволяє цілі Переміститися наступого ходу.

_en_original: Your heals now inflict a stack of Poison instead of healing.
en: Your healing effects apply Poison instead of healing.
tr: İyileştirme efektlerin iyileştirmek yerine Zehir uygular.
uk: Твої атаки і навички Отруюють ціль замість лікування.

_en_original: You can Attack twice in a turn. Your POW is reduced by 30%.
en: You can perform your Basic Attack twice, but your Power is reduced by 30%.
tr: Temel Saldırını 2 kez kullanabilirsin, ama Gücün %30 azalır.
uk: Ти можеш використати Базову Атаку двічі, але твоя Сила зменшена на 30%.

_en_original: When moving, by yourself or affected by an enemy, deal 5 damage to allies you pass.
en: You deal 5 damage to crewmates you pass through whenever you move or are moved.
tr: Hareket ettiğinde veya ettirildiğinde üzerinden geçtiğin müttefiklere 5 hasar verirsin.
uk: Ти наносиш 5 шкоди товаришам, які Переміщуються або Переміщені через тебе.

_en_original: You cannot be healed by others, you heal by 10% of your health every turn.
en: You regain 10% of your Health every turn, but you can’t be healed by others.
tr: Her tur Canının %10’u iyileşir, ama başkaları tarafından iyileştirilemezsin.
uk: Зцілись на 10% Здоров'я кожного ходу, але тебе не можуть зцілити інші.

_en_original: There are peanuts on the ground! If not Picked Up & Crunched this turn, a flock of seagulls will swoop in to fight for them, dealing 20 damage and applying 1 Nasty Cuts stack.
en: If not Crunched this turn, seagulls will swoop in, dealing 20 damage and applying Nasty Cuts.
tr: Bu tur Çitlenmezse martılar çullanarak 20 hasar verecek ve Fena Kesikler’e neden olacak.
uk: Якщо не Сточений цього ходу, налетять чайки, нанесуть 20 шкоди і Глибокі Порізи.

_en_original: There's blackpowder on the ground! Taking explosive damage makes it BLOW for 25 damage, and 15 damage to adjacent spots.
en: Incoming Explosive damage makes the powder blow up for 25 damage to this spot and 15 to adjacent spots.
tr: Patlayıcı hasar barutu patlatarak o sıraya 25 ve yanlarına 15’er hasar verir.
uk: Враження від Вибухової атаки призводить до вибуху пороху, що завдає 25 одиниць шкоди цій клітинці та 15 одиниць сусіднім.

_en_original: While on the spot with Sootgut, a cat receives a 50% reduction to all incoming attack damage.
en: All incoming attack damage halved while in cover behind Sootgut.
tr: Külkarni’nin arkasında sığınırken alınan tüm saldırı hasarı yarılanır.
uk: Усі вхідні пошкодження від атак зменшуються вдвічі, коли персонаж перебуває в укритті за Казаном.

_en_original: Every 10% of health lost adds 15% to POW and Skill damage. Attack can only hit directly in front of you.
en: The Wringer’s Basic Attack can only target in front of him. Every 10% of Health he’s missing increases damage dealt by 15%.
tr: Defter Düren’in Temel Saldırısı sadece hemen önünü hedefleyebilir. Kaybettiği her %10 Can verdiği hasarı %15 artırır.
uk: Бугай може атакувати тільки цілі перед собою. Кожні відсутні 10% Здоров'я збільшують його атаку на 15%.

_en_original: Your attack makes a target stumble backward, shifting positions. As long as you’re above 80% HP, you deal additional 15 damage with your Attack and Skill.
en: Bones’ Basic Attack knocks the target back. As long as she’s above 80% Health, she deals an additional 15 damage with her Basic Attack and Skill.
tr: Asu’nun Temel Saldırısı hedefi arkaya iter. %80 Can üzerinde olduğu sürece Temel Saldırısı ve Yeteneği 15 ek hasar verir.
uk: Базова атака Боцману відкидає ціль назад. Поки її запас здоров’я перевищує 80 %, вона завдає додаткових 15 шкоди своєю Базовою Атакою та Умінням.

_en_original: Scuttler O’Riley starts the battle with a big pot (called Sootgut) on the same spot. While on the spot with Sootgut, a cat receives a 50% reduction to all incoming attack damage.
en: O’Riley starts with a big pot (called Sootgut) which they can move around. Sootgut provides cover, halving all incoming attack damage.
tr: Batur Külkarni adında hareket ettirebildiği büyük bir kazanla başlar. Külkarni’nin arkasında sığınırken alınan tüm saldırı hasarı yarılanır.
uk: Павук починає битву з Казаном, який вони можуть переміщувати. Казан надає укриття і зменшує отриману шкоду на 50%.

_en_original: Every time you deal damage, deal 50% of it to adjacent targets. Every time you TAKE damage, deal 40% of it to adjacent teammates.
en: When Parrish deals damage, they also deal 50% of it to adjacent mutineers. When they take damage, adjacent crewmates also take 40% of it.
tr: Kıvılcım hasar verdiğinde hasarın %50’sini bitişik asilere de verir, hasar aldığında ise hasarın %40’ını bitişik müttefikler de alır.
uk: Коли Підпали-Порох атакує заколотника, вони також наносять 50% шкоди до сусідніх заколотників. Коли Підпали-Порох атаковний, сусідні товариші також отримують 40% шкоди.

_en_original: Every cat in front of Gut-you Gutierrez receives a 25% damage negation buff, "Watched over".
en: Crewmates in front of Gutierrez take 25% less damage.
tr: Şahin’in önündeki müttefikler %25 daha az hasar alır.
uk: Товариші перед Лайдаком втрачають на 25% менше Здоров'я від атак.

_en_original: Attack is a free action you can use every turn. Attack throws a couple hardtack biscuits that deal damage first, then heal for the same amount.
en: Desmond’s Basic Attack doesn’t end his turn, first dealing damage, then healing for the same amount.
tr: Pirhan’ın Temel Saldırısı verdiği hasarın ardından aynı miktarda iyileştirir ve turu bitirmez.
uk: Базова Атака Сдибора не закінчує його хід. Вона спочатку віднімає Здоров'я, а потім лікує на ту ж саму кількість.

_en_original: Allies while standing next to you receive a 25% POW bonus and heal for 5 health at the end of the team’s turn.
en: Crewmates next to Mary have 25% increased Power, and heal for 5 Health at the end of each turn.
tr: Gülşen’e bitişik müttefiklerin Gücü %25 artar ve her tur sonunda 5’er Canı iyileşir.
uk: Сила сусідніх товаришів Маряки збільшена на 25% і лікуються на 5 Здоров'я у кінці кожного ходу.

_en_original: Receive a stackable +5 POW if you haven’t moved from your spot since last turn. Lose all stacks when you move.
en: Selma gains a stacking +5 Power if she hasn’t moved since her last turn. Moving removes all stacks.
tr: Selma geçen turdan beri hareket etmemişse +5 Güç daha kazanır. Hareket etmek tüm birikimi sıfırlar.
uk: Куль-Лиха отримує стек +5 Сили, якщо вона не змінила свою позицію останнього ходу. Рух обнуляє стек.

_en_original: Next instance of sparking damage ignites target, dealing damage and stunning it.
en: Incoming Sparking damage sets you on fire, dealing 30 damage and causing you to lose your next turn.
tr: Yakıcı hasar seni tutuşturarak 30 hasar verir ve sıradaki turunu kaybetmene neden olur.
uk: Іскристі атаки запалюють тебе, наносять 30 шкоди і змушують пропустити наступний хід.

_en_original: You gain a 25% bonus to POW, and heal 5 damage at the end of your team's turn.
en: Your Power is increased by 25%, and you heal for 5 Health at the end of each turn.
tr: Gücün %25 artar, ve her tur sonunda 5 Canın iyileşir.
uk: Твоя Сила збільшена на 25% і ти лікуєш 5 Здоров'я у кінці кожного ходу.

_en_original: You cannot move by yourself this turn.
At the beginning of your team's next turn, deliver a devastating 40-damage punch in front of you.
en: Next turn, deal 40 damage in front of you.
tr: Gelecek tur, bir ileriye 40 hasar ver.
uk: Наступного ходу атакує ціль перед собою на 40 шкоди.

_en_original: Damage and healing received doubled in the next 3 instances.
en: The next 3 instances of incoming healing and damage are doubled.
tr: Sıradaki 3 kez alınan iyileştirme ve hasar ikiye katlanacak.
uk: Наступні 3 атаки або зцілення втричі сильніше.

_en_original: Every stack of Nasty Cuts deals 5 damage to you at the beginning of your turn. Can’t be removed.
en: You take 5 damage for every stack of Nasty Cuts at the start of your turn.
tr: Birikmiş her Fena Kesik için tur başında 5 hasar alacaksın.
uk: Втрачає 5 Здоров'я за кожний стек Глибоких Порізів на початку свого ходу.

_en_original: For the next two turns, if you are hit by slung slop, you become stunned and lose your turn.
en: If you are targeted by Sling Slop again next turn, you become Stunned and lose your turn.
tr: Sıradaki tur tekrar Lapa Fırlatma ile hedeflenirsen Sersemleyerek sıradaki turunu kaybedersin.
uk: Розлив Бурди Приголомшує тебе і ти пропускаєш хід.

_en_original: Your next basic attack is stronger. (+50% POW)
en: Your next Basic Attack has 50% more Power.

_en_original: Take 2 damage at the end of your team's turn. Every stack of Poison beyond the first doubles this damage.
en: You take 2 damage at the end of turn. Every stack of Poison beyond the first doubles this damage.
tr: Tur sonunda 2 hasar alacaksın. İlkinin üzerine biriken her Zehir bu hasarı ikiye katlar.
uk: Втрачає 2 Здоров'я у кінці кожного ходу. Кожний стек Яду, вище одного, збільшує шкоду вдвічі.

_en_original: The target's next attack will MISS.
You have increased POW. Lose this bonus when you move.
en: You have increased Power. Moving removes all stacks.
tr: Gücün arttı. Hareket etmek tüm birikimi sıfırlar.

_en_original:
You are a rich, bored heir of an expansive(ly dilapidated) family, whose vaults are running dry. Dwindling gold supply would not stop you from pursuing your latest foolish whim.
Space-faring Buccaneering.

Every dingy moon bursts with gold, undiscovered species and titillating substances to bring back and sell, or so you heard. And all it takes is a ship and a crew to prance your way to the prize and escort the bulging treasure chests back with you.
en:
You’re the heir of an expansive(ly dilapidated) family, and your vaults are running dry.

But this would not deter you from your latest whim: Space-faring buccaneering.

Every dingy moon is bursting with gold, undiscovered species and titillating substances.

All it would take is a ship and a crew to prance your way in and grab the prize.
tr:
Mirasçısı olduğun eski sosyete ailesinin paraları artık suyunu çekiyor.

Ancak bu yeni hevesinden seni alıkoyamayacak: Uzay yolculuğu korsanlığı.

Her dandik ay altınla, keşfedilmemiş canlılarla ve heyecanlı maddelerle dolu.

İçeri hoplayıp ödülünü kapmak için tek ihtiyacın olan bir gemi ve mürettebat.
uk:
Ти - спадкоємець великого (але вкрай занепалого) роду. Твої скарбниці порожніють.

Але це не завадить тобі втілити свою нову примху: космічне піратство.

Кожен занедбаний місяць переповнений золотом, невідомими видами та збудливими речовинами.

Все, що тобі потрібно - це корабель і екіпаж, щоб увірватися туди і забрати приз.

_en_original: You have overpayed greatly for every trinket, tool, crew member, and the eagerly-sold ship, Mendacity.
en: You overpaid greatly for every tool, trinket and crew member, and for the eagerly-sold ship, Mendacity.
tr: Her araç gereç, ıvır zıvır, mürettebat ve hatta şevkle satılan gemi Vefasız için çok fazla para ödedin.
uk: Ти значно переплатив за кожен інструмент, дрібничку та члена екіпажу, а також за корабель «Ренегат», який так охоче продавали.

_en_original: You hope that was enough to earn their loyalty and camaraderie.
en: You hoped that would be enough to earn their loyalty and camaraderie.
tr: Sadakat ve dostluklarını kazanmak için bunun yeterli olacağını umuyordun.
uk: Ти сподівався, що цього вистачить, аби завоювати їхню вірність і дружбу.

_en_original: For you hired, from odds and ends, the most backstab-happy, scheming crew of bastards in this stellar cluster. They do not trust you, and they do not trust each other. You would best hope that, when their inevitable mutiny happens, at least some of them will be willing to stay by your side.
en:
For you’ve hired the most backstab-happy crew of bastards in this cluster.
They do not trust you, and they do not trust each other.
You hope that, when the inevitable happens, some would stand by you.
tr:
Çünkü bu yıldız kümesi içerisindeki en kalleş mürettebatı seçmişsin.
Ne sana, ne de birbirlerine güveniyorlar.  Tek ümidin, kaçınılmaz
olayın ardından, en azından bazılarının senin yanında yer alması.
uk:
Адже з усіх негідників ти найняв найпідступніших піратів.
Вони не довіряють тобі. Не довіряють один одному.
Лишилось тільки сподіватись, що коли станеться неминуче, хтось все-таки стане на твій бік.

en:
To the victor go the spoils!
It’s time to lick your wounds,
but be wary, supplies are limited!
tr:
Ganimet kazananın olur!
Şimdi yaralarını sarma vakti,
ama dikkat, malzemeler sınırlı!
uk:
Здобич для переможців!
Час зализати свої рани,
але стережись, бо запаси обмежені!
